newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends steady, but nerves frayed by EU.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends steady, but nerves frayed by EU.

text.p: 1500 GMT - The Swiss franc closed steady against the dollar, but dealers' nerves frayed by the European Union's Amsterdam summit and a growing feeling that the single currency project could be postponed or the Maastricht criteria be watered down.
Both dollar and franc have benefitted from safe-haven buying in past and dollar moved rapidly above 1.4450 in late trading.
Inflation data from Basle next week expected to show slight rise due to franc depreciation and thus remove lingering speculation the Swiss National Bank could cut discount rate.
* Dollar closes at 1.4425/4435 francs vs today's opener of 1.4435/4445 and Thursday's closing 1.4421/4431.
* Mark closes at 83.27/30 centimes vs its opening 83.45/48 and yesterday's closing 83.71/73
